17 YEARS · ONE MISSION

Built by a veteran.
Crafted by rural women.

Light Weight Technology began with a military veteran's conviction that protection shouldn't cost the planet. Today, our team — most of them rural women from villages around Thirumazhisai — turns kraft paper into honeycomb structures strong enough to replace wood, thermocol and plastic. Our connector designs are patent-protected, and every board that leaves our floor carries the same promise: protection for your product, none for plastic.

17+Years in paper honeycomb
